editorial:
Imagine you have a perfect life with a great job and a beautiful wife, but then one case changes everything. You meet Michel, a top-tier lawyer who decides to defend Cécile, a young woman caught up in a jewelry store robbery. From the moment they meet, there is a spark that Michel cannot ignore. He starts as her lawyer, but he quickly becomes obsessed with her. The vibe is a slow burn that feels like a car crash in slow motion because you can see his life falling apart, but you cannot stop watching. It is a heavy look at how a mid-life crisis can lead someone to throw away eighteen years of marriage for a total stranger.

What really makes this work is the acting. You can feel the tension every time the husband and wife argue about his new obsession. The pacing is steady, though some might find the middle a bit slow. If you enjoy emotional dramas about forbidden love and bad choices, you will love this. Since it is an older film, you should try to find a high-quality digital version. If you can, rent it on Apple TV or look for a remastered Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is definitely worth the time if you want a movie that makes you think about loyalty.
endingExplained: In the end, Michel completely loses his grip on his old life. He abandons his successful career and his marriage to be with Cécile. However, it is not a fairy tale. The movie shows that their relationship is built on chaos and desperation rather than a healthy foundation. He trades his security for a passionate but unstable life, leaving his wife behind to deal with the wreckage of their broken home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about forbidden romance and life-changing mistakes.
